title: Sri Jaya and Gambang interchanges on East Coast Expressway flooded, motorists advised to call off journey | The Star
text:
Sri Jaya and Gambang interchanges on East Coast Expressway flooded, motorists advised to call off journey | The Star
KUANTAN: Motorists who wish to make trips between Kuantan and Kuala Lumpur through the East Coast Expressway are advised to call off their journey for the moment as a section of the highway is flooded.
Concessionaire ANIH Berhad said about one kilometre at KM198, between the Sri Jaya and Gambang interchanges, had been flooded under at least two feet of water.
